verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents privacy controls: PII handling, opting out of model improvement, a time-to-live for audio and transcripts, and BAA signing. None of these lets a user choose a storage region or data residency. Data retention settings are an adjacent control and earn no credit, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
